column1: # OTA partition table for the MatrixPortal S3 (8MB flash).
# CRITICAL: creds.rs / brightness.rs / identity.rs write RAW flash offsets
# the board identity survive both the flag-day reflash and every OTA update.
# Do NOT move or shrink nvs.
# esp-bootloader-esp-idf's OtaUpdater requires the otadata partition and two
# non-factory app slots; espflash writes this table (as binary) at 0x8000
# offset the bootloader reads it from. App slots hold 3MB each (image ~1MB).
# With otadata erased/blank the bootloader falls back to booting ota_0 —
# scripts/flash.sh erases otadata and targets ota_0 for exactly that reason.
